themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Comments on the wood-fired or chargrilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including flavor, size, preparation and the sauce they are served in. Also covers oysters being unavailable or served differently than expected.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Comments on the fried alligator appetizer, including texture, the chili garlic mayo or aioli coating, seasoning and how it compares to other gator.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Comments on the rabbit and dumplings entree, including the rabbit meat, the biscuit-style dumplings, the gravy, seasoning and portion.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon entree
themes.description: Comments on the signature Louisiana cochon pulled-pork dish with cabbage, cracklins and pickled peaches or turnips, including moisture, temperature and how it lives up to being the namesake dish.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: Comments on the braised or paneed pork cheeks, including tenderness, sauce, accompaniments and portion size.

themes.name: Smoked pork ribs
themes.description: Comments on the smoked pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, dryness, sauce, spice and how many ribs come on the plate.

themes.name: Macaroni and cheese
themes.description: Comments on the mac and cheese casserole side, including cheesiness, flavor, richness and size.

themes.name: Fried boudin
themes.description: Comments on the fried boudin balls served with mustard and pickled peppers, including texture, filling and flavor.

themes.name: Smoked ham hock
themes.description: Comments on the smoked ham hock entree and its accompaniments such as black-eyed peas, sweet potatoes or greens, including tenderness, smokiness and saltiness.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: Comments on the gumbo, including the varieties offered, flavor, saltiness, serving size and price.

themes.name: Complimentary bread
themes.description: Comments on the free warm rolls and butter, including how good they are, and whether they were offered, delayed, refilled or withheld.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Comments on the desserts, such as the pineapple upside-down cake, hummingbird cake, pies and chocolate cake, including taste and quality.

themes.name: Cocktails and drink selection
themes.description: Comments on the drinks themselves, including cocktails, bourbon and whiskey flights, moonshine, beer and wine lists, and drink prices. Behavior of bartenders or servers belongs under service, not here.

themes.name: Prices and portion sizes
themes.description: Comments on cost, value for money and how much food is served relative to what is charged, including small plates, bill totals and leaving hungry.

themes.name: Waitstaff and bar service
themes.description: Comments on servers, bartenders and runners, including attentiveness, speed, friendliness, attitude, menu knowledge, order accuracy, check handling and how problems were handled.

themes.name: Reservations and seating
themes.description: Comments on the host stand, reservation handling, wait times, walk-ins, table assignment and seating policies. Includes hostess behavior and being turned away or seated late.

themes.name: Atmosphere and noise
themes.description: Comments on the decor, space, ambiance, noise level, crowding, temperature and comfort of the dining room and seating.

themes.name: Cochon Butcher comparison
themes.description: Comments comparing the restaurant to its sister sandwich shop, Cochon Butcher next door, or mixing up the two, including preferences between them.
